text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — finalize the competitive battlecard + webinar narrative for next Thurs. Need one-liner differentiators vs cloud AI, a succinct benchmark callout, and inbound routing rules for MQLs that mention latency/cost concerns.
Sam (Product): Uploaded latest benchmark sheet: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks — main callouts: 2x lower p99 vs CloudX on 8k tokens, ~30% lower unit cost vs ModelAPI with caching. See 'notes' column for caveats.
Anika (Content): I can turn the bench callouts into one slide + a 3-sentence social post. Which metric should be the hero — latency or unit-cost?
Jordan (Sales): Hero varies by persona: latency for infra/platform teams, unit-cost and predictability for procurement. Also need two short objection scripts: 1) Why not CloudX managed endpoints? 2) Why not self-hosted infra vendors?
Leo (Growth): For inbound routing, proposed rules (simple pseudocode to share with eng):
```
if mention("latency") or mention("SLA") or company_size >= 500:
  route = "enterprise-dedicated"
elif intent == "eval" and company_size < 50:
  route = "self-serve-nurture"
elif keyword("benchmark"):
  route = "solutions-eng"
else:
  route = "growth-nurture"
```
Maya (Marketing): @Leo — add a trigger for 'benchmark' please. We want bench requests to hit Solutions Eng directly. Also add a tag for "needs-battlecard" so sales gets the one-pager. :memo:
LeadRouterBot: Rule draft received. Will validate and deploy a test route (staging).
Sam (Product): Small caveat on the 2x p99 — that's with KV caching + condensed kernels enabled. Recommend callout: "typical production with prefix/KV caching" in the slide footnote so it's not misleading.
Anika (Content): Got it. I'll add the footnote copy and a 1-line caveat under the benchmark graphic. Draft slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood/slides/warroom — comment on slide 2 for the exact phrasing.
Jordan (Sales): I'll draft two short scripts and a TL;DR battlecard variant for SDRs (30s pitch + rebuttals). Will post by EOD.
Leo (Growth): I'll add the routing rules to the playbook and include an example webhook payload for Salesforce lead assignment.
Maya (Marketing): OK locking the narrative: webinar hero = "Predictable latency + predictable unit cost" with two benchmark callouts (p99 and unit-cost). Action items: @Sam update notes on benchmark sheet, @Anika finalize slide + social copy, @Jordan write the 2 scripts and SDR TL;DR, @Leo finalize routing rules and add 'benchmark' trigger. Prep checklist due Tue COB.
Sam (Product): On it — will update the sheet and add a short methodology blurb.
Anika (Content): Will finish slide edits and social copy tonight :rocket:.
Jordan (Sales): Script drafts incoming later today.
LeadRouterBot: Rule deployed to staging at 1918374700. Will promote to prod after manual QA.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — shout if blockers. :heart:
